question: What is the meeting point of the Western Ghats and the Eastern Ghats?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Nilgiri Hills.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The meeting point of the **Western Ghats and the Eastern Ghats** is the Nilgiri Hills.
 
• The Nilgiri Hills are located in the **southern part of India** and are a part of the Western Ghats.
 
• These hills are also known as the **Blue Mountains **and are a major tourist attraction in the region.
 
• The Nilgiri Hills are known for their **natural beauty, tea plantations, and wildlife sanctuaries.**
 
• The meeting point of the Western Ghats and the Eastern Ghats at the Nilgiri Hills is an** important geographical landmark** in India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Palkonda Hills:**

 
 
• These hills are located in the state of **Andhra Pradesh **and are a part of the** Eastern Ghats.**
 
 
 
• **Cardamom Hills:****​ **
 
 
• **​**These hills are located in the state of** Kerala** and are a part of the **Western Ghats.**
 
 
 
• **Nallamala Hills**:
 
 
• These hills are located in the state of **Andhra Pradesh** and are a part of the** Eastern Ghats.**
